say:1:1710842001:1.text: Do not worry about me. The shield deflected that strike.
say:1:1710842001:1.source_cn: 我没事，梅林。护盾挡住了致命一击。
say:1:1710842001:1.male: Do not worry about me. The shield deflected that strike.
say:1:1710842001:1.female: Do not worry about me. The shield deflected that strike.

say:2:1710842002:1.text: But the shockwave reached Maximilian... his condition worsened. I must ask for your help again.
say:2:1710842002:1.source_cn: 但这冲击波及到了马克西姆……他的状态很不好，必须再拜托...
say:2:1710842002:1.male: But the shockwave reached Maximilian... his condition worsened. I must ask for your help again.
say:2:1710842002:1.female: But the shockwave reached Maximilian... his condition worsened. I must ask for your help again.

choice_prompt:3:1710842002.text: But the shockwave reached Maximilian... his condition worsened. I must ask for your help again.
choice_prompt:3:1710842002.source_cn: 但这冲击波及到了马克西姆……他的状态很不好，必须再拜托你一次了。
choice_prompt:3:1710842002.male: But the shockwave reached Maximilian... his condition worsened. I must ask for your help again.
choice_prompt:3:1710842002.female: But the shockwave reached Maximilian... his condition worsened. I must ask for your help again.

say:4:1710842003:1.text: His breathing has stabilized for now.
say:4:1710842003:1.source_cn: 马克西姆的气息……暂时稳住了。
say:4:1710842003:1.male: His breathing has stabilized for now.
say:4:1710842003:1.female: His breathing has stabilized for now.

say:5:1710842004:1.text: As for Cyran... I never imagined that traitor would dare storm the palace himself.
say:5:1710842004:1.source_cn: 只是迪尔格雷……那个叛徒。我没想到他竟然胆大妄为到直接...
say:5:1710842004:1.male: As for Cyran... I never imagined that traitor would dare storm the palace himself.
say:5:1710842004:1.female: As for Cyran... I never imagined that traitor would dare storm the palace himself.

say:6:1710842005:1.text: What of Savannah and the Hall of Ancients? Have Peggy and the others returned safely?
say:6:1710842005:1.source_cn: 赛凡纳和圣古堂现在是什么情况？佩吉她们平安归来了吗？
say:6:1710842005:1.male: What of Savannah and the Hall of Ancients? Have Peggy and the others returned safely?
say:6:1710842005:1.female: What of Savannah and the Hall of Ancients? Have Peggy and the others returned safely?

say:7:1710842006:1.text: You recount everything—Orion's return with Peggy and Cassadee, the failed attempt to draw the sword, Rolan's reappearance.
say:7:1710842006:1.source_cn: 你将今天在圣古堂发生的一切全盘托出——从奥利安带着佩吉...
say:7:1710842006:1.male: You recount everything—Orion's return with Peggy and Cassadee, the failed attempt to draw the sword, Rolan's reappearance.
say:7:1710842006:1.female: You recount everything—Orion's return with Peggy and Cassadee, the failed attempt to draw the sword, Rolan's reappearance.

say:8:1710842007:1.text: ... That fox was truly King Rolan? Go on.
say:8:1710842007:1.source_cn: ……那只狐狸，果然是罗兰大帝吗？请继续说。
say:8:1710842007:1.male: ... That fox was truly King Rolan? Go on.
say:8:1710842007:1.female: ... That fox was truly King Rolan? Go on.

say:9:1710842008:1.text: You describe Cyran's scheme, the <style="highlight">rift</style> he tore open, and Orion fleeing.
say:9:1710842008:1.source_cn: 你接着讲述了迪尔格雷在阴谋败露后，于圣古堂附近撕开了召...
say:9:1710842008:1.male: You describe Cyran's scheme, the <style="highlight">rift</style> he tore open, and Orion fleeing.
say:9:1710842008:1.female: You describe Cyran's scheme, the <style="highlight">rift</style> he tore open, and Orion fleeing.

say:12:1710842010:1.text: I see. With his plot exposed, Cyran struck at the root.
say:12:1710842010:1.source_cn: 我明白了。 迪尔格雷的阴谋败露后，他选择了釜底抽薪。
say:12:1710842010:1.male: I see. With his plot exposed, Cyran struck at the root.
say:12:1710842010:1.female: I see. With his plot exposed, Cyran struck at the root.

say:13:1710842011:1.text: If Maximilian and I had fallen, the Empire would have been plunged into chaos.
say:13:1710842011:1.source_cn: 只要除掉了马克西姆和我，耀光就会陷入大乱，他也能达到一...
say:13:1710842011:1.male: If Maximilian and I had fallen, the Empire would have been plunged into chaos.
say:13:1710842011:1.female: If Maximilian and I had fallen, the Empire would have been plunged into chaos.

say:15:1710842013:1.text: Thank you for saving my husband, and preserving what dignity remains of the royal court.
say:15:1710842013:1.source_cn: 感谢你拯救了我的丈夫，也帮助保存了王室最后一点尊严。
say:15:1710842013:1.male: Thank you for saving my husband, and preserving what dignity remains of the royal court.
say:15:1710842013:1.female: Thank you for saving my husband, and preserving what dignity remains of the royal court.

say:16:1710842014:1.text: This is my post. I will hold it.
say:16:1710842014:1.source_cn: 这里是我的“席位”，我会守住。
say:16:1710842014:1.male: This is my post. I will hold it.
say:16:1710842014:1.female: This is my post. I will hold it.

say:17:1710842015:1.text: Go. King Rolan, Cassadee... and Peggy. They need you.
say:17:1710842015:1.source_cn: 去吧。罗兰大帝、科丝蒂……还有佩吉，他们需要你。
say:17:1710842015:1.male: Go. King Rolan, Cassadee... and Peggy. They need you.
say:17:1710842015:1.female: Go. King Rolan, Cassadee... and Peggy. They need you.

say:18:1710842016:1.text: The strongest mage must end this catastrophe.
say:18:1710842016:1.source_cn: 需要最强的大魔法师，去终结这场灾难。
say:18:1710842016:1.male: The strongest mage must end this catastrophe.
say:18:1710842016:1.female: The strongest mage must end this catastrophe.

choice_prompt:19:1710842016.text: The strongest mage must end this catastrophe.
choice_prompt:19:1710842016.source_cn: 需要最强的大魔法师，去终结这场灾难。
choice_prompt:19:1710842016.male: The strongest mage must end this catastrophe.
choice_prompt:19:1710842016.female: The strongest mage must end this catastrophe.

say:20:1710842017:1.text: As you did over twenty years ago during the Second Divine War—
say:20:1710842017:1.source_cn: 你不再多言。正如二十多年前，第二次神魔大战期间，你们俩...
say:20:1710842017:1.male: As you did over twenty years ago during the Second Divine War—
say:20:1710842017:1.female: As you did over twenty years ago during the Second Divine War—

say:21:1710842018:1.text: You solemnly salute her, and turn toward the final battlefield.
say:21:1710842018:1.source_cn: 你向她郑重致意，随后转身，奔赴最后的战场。
say:21:1710842018:1.male: You solemnly salute her, and turn toward the final battlefield.
say:21:1710842018:1.female: You solemnly salute her, and turn toward the final battlefield.

choice:11:1:2.text: She's holding the line with Rolan and Cassadee.
choice:11:1:2.source_cn: 她正和罗兰、科丝蒂坚守在那里
choice:11:1:2.male: She's holding the line with Rolan and Cassadee.
choice:11:1:2.female: She's holding the line with Rolan and Cassadee.
